answer: Production deploys on Fridays are no longer permitted to prevent incidents like INC-042 from occurring over the weekend (D1). This policy supersedes Anika's previous 2025 decision which had set the production release window to Friday afternoon (D3, C2). As owned by Mei, the current rule applies to all production deploys, including scheduled jobs and configuration-only releases (D1).
